examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Controlled theme switcher; defaults to the system mode. Click a segment and the highlight slides to it.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ThemeSwitcher from '@aziontech/webkit/theme-switcher'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const theme = ref('system')
</script>

<template>
  <ThemeSwitcher v-model="theme" />
</template>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: The whole control is disabled and applies disabled tokens; no segment can be selected.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ThemeSwitcher from '@aziontech/webkit/theme-switcher'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const theme = ref('system')
</script>

<template>
  <ThemeSwitcher
    v-model="theme"
    disabled
  />
</template>
